verdict.rationale: A state business-filing portal could plausibly offer event-triggered automation such as filing-status rules, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no user-definable rules that trigger actions on events. The Electronic AR Reminder and the GovDelivery subscription are fixed notifications, an adjacent feature rather than configurable event-driven automation, and probes found no API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
